botanical_master: Your garden has become the finest botanical sanctuary in the entire valley!
I'm honored to supply seeds for a master herbalist like you.
default: Greetings, professor! The soil is rich today. Need any fresh seeds or looking to sell your harvest?
first_harvest: Splendid harvest! You can sell extra crops to me for Gold, or keep them for synthesis experiments.
Speaking of experiments... have you tried taking two different crops to your Synthesis Lab (C)?
first_hybrid: By the Great Oak! You actually synthesized a brand new hybrid species?!
I knew your biology background would bear fruit! What other impossible combinations might exist?
intro: Ah, welcome to the valley, professor! It's peaceful here, isn't it?
I heard you used to teach biology. These soils are far more intriguing than ordinary earth.
Take some starter seeds from my stall, plant them, and see what botanical wonders emerge!
